integrity: A direct symbolic symmetrization identity and independently assembled Fourier-grid checks accompany an analytic proof. Finite checks do not establish universal inequalities. No independent mathematical audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact hydrodynamic-PDE assertion for classical periodic solutions; the exponential estimate assumes a pointwise density cap throughout the time interval, not merely initially. It neither proves cap invariance nor microscopic finite-size stability, high-density phase coexistence, or unconditional global mixing. Publication priority has residual risk of implicit general symmetrizer/active-hydrodynamic coverage.
title: Sharp half-filling entropy barrier in active-exclusion hydrodynamics
